headline: Island Battles Rage as Central Fronts Endure Savage Bloodshed
war_summary: Since the afternoon dispatch, the conflict has escalated into ferocious coastal assaults and severe attrition across the interior. Fisherman’s Row has erupted into the war’s most violent flashpoint, logging fourteen strategic base transactions in two hours as custody of Eidolo, Black Well, and Dankana Post swung repeatedly. Stlican Shelf maintained its fierce pace with nine recent transfers centered on Breaker Town. In Weathered Expanse, territorial instability reignited with five base shifts in the two-hour span, accompanied by an appalling toll of more than three thousand combined casualties. Fresh unrest also broke out in Marban Hollow, where Mox saw four rapid transactions, while Mooring County yielded two base captures amidst ongoing bombardments. Conversely, Palantine Berm has fallen completely silent after its earlier skirmishes. Although Callahan’s Passage recorded no shifts in ownership over the last two hours, combat there reached fever pitch, devouring nearly three thousand troops in the latest hour alone around The Crumbling Passage.
